name: Boom Chaka Laka | 1.3g Live Resin Tarantula | Blue Raz Zlushie
description: Cool, tangy, and straight-up delicious — Blue Raz Zlushie brings the chill with a berry blast of flavor and a smooth, balanced high. This hybrid hits that sweet spot between laid-back and lit-up, perfect for any vibe, anytime. Think frosty blue raspberry with a zing that lingers.
